title: The derived pullback commutes with the derived tensor product
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes. Write $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$ for module objects over the pulled-back ring on the pro-étale site of $T$, $f^*$ for the (exact, monoidal) pullback of module objects, $Lf^*$ for its left derived functor and $\otimes^L$ for the derived tensor product [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]; $Q_h\colon K(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})\to D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$ is the localization of the homotopy category. The comparison $m\colon Lf^*(K\otimes^LL)\to Lf^*K\otimes^LLf^*L$, the natural transformation of bifunctors on $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y})$ induced by the universal property of left derived bifunctors from the counits, is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Identify the prescribed left counit with the existing upstream Functor.leftDerivedDerivedTensorCounit by extensionality in the two homotopy objects and reflexivity of their components. The existing upstream Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor₂_leftDerivedDerivedTensor then shows that the left bifunctor, with precisely this counit, is left derived. The right bifunctor is left derived by the already proved isLeftDerivedFunctor₂_upperStarTensor.

For two left derived bifunctors with the same target, the universal lift of one counit along the other is the canonical leftDerived₂NatTrans of the identity of that target: unfolding leftDerived₂NatTrans and composing with an identity proves this equality. The existing upstream isomorphism instance for leftDerived₂NatTrans applied to the identity proves that this lift is an isomorphism. Specialize this private categorical lemma to the two bifunctors and their actual counits; the resulting lift is definitionally leftDerivedUpperStarTensor. This uses no identification with a separately chosen tensor comparison.

instance isIso_leftDerivedUpperStarTensor : IsIso (leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f) := by
  have hQ (P Q : HomotopyCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y)) (.up ℤ))
      (hP : (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
      (hQ : (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q) :
      IsIso (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)).app
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj Q)) := by
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := P.quotient_obj_surjective
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := Q.quotient_obj_surjective
    exact isIso_leftDerivedUpperStarTensor_app_app_Qh_obj Λ f P Q hP hQ
  have (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))) :
      IsIso ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app K) := by
    obtain ⟨P, hP, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_kFlat_iso_Qh_obj Λ K
    have (M : DerivedCategory
        (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))) :
        IsIso (((leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)).app M) := by
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ', ⟨e'⟩⟩ := exists_kFlat_iso_Qh_obj Λ M
      have := hQ P Q hP hQ'
      exact NatTrans.isIso_app_of_iso _ e'.symm
    have : IsIso ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) :=
      NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
    exact NatTrans.isIso_app_of_iso _ e.symm
  exact NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
